title: Sources: TSMC is exploring plans to work with Elon Musk's Terafab project as it mulls a presence in Texas, adding to its existing plans to expand in Arizona (Tim Culpan/Culpium)
summary: Tim Culpan / Culpium: Sources: TSMC is exploring plans to work with Elon Musk's Terafab project as it mulls a presence in Texas, adding to its existing plans to expand in Arizona — [Exclusive] Taiwanese foundry giant may use Terafab as anchor client for a future Texas semiconductor factory.
